summary: IHS Holding Ltd furnished a Form 6-K reporting the distribution of its Notice of Annual General Meeting and Proxy Statement for the 2026 AGM scheduled for October 8, 2026, in London. The filing is a routine notice of meeting and proxy solicitation, with no special-situation transaction, strategic event, or abrupt management change described. The meeting agenda and voting procedures are standard for annual meetings. As this is an ordinary meeting notice rather than a special situation, the appropriate classification is None.
